title: ApexOS Portfolio
shortDescription: A premium desktop operating system portfolio interface built with Next.js.
fullDescription: ApexOS simulates a complete web-based operating system. It features draggable window panels, custom settings, dynamic wallpapers, wallpaper changes, a notifications system, custom registry loader, and flagship applications for presenting portfolios in an immersive interactive style.
features: Draggable window management with focus layering
Dynamic background wallpaper system from settings
Custom notifications popover with tray integration
Adaptive device shells (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile)
architectureHighlights: Window focus stack managed via an index-based subscription store
Translucent frosted glass styling implemented using CSS custom properties
Component-based application registration and dynamic runtime mounting
challenges: Enforcing window focus layering and smooth CSS animations concurrently
Supporting Server-Side Rendering (SSR) without hydration mismatch in system settings
solutions: Used window focus stack indexing with react state lifecycle hookup
Implemented client-only dynamic loading wrapper and localStorage safe helpers
results: Boot-to-Desktop flow runs in under 3 seconds
Recruiters report high engagement with immersive master-detail interactive reels

title: FitTrack Pro
shortDescription: A mobile fitness companion app supporting workout analytics and social sharing.
fullDescription: FitTrack Pro is a cross-platform mobile app designed to help athletes track their workouts, monitor real-time heart rate via Bluetooth integrations, and share progress logs with their fitness circles. Includes rich charts and native storage backups.
features: Offline-first local workout logging with SQLite
Real-time sensor graphs using react-native-reanimated
Social leaderboard feeds with instant sync
architectureHighlights: Batched local database write transactions to avoid thread blocking
Native thread visual animation executing using react-native-reanimated
challenges: Frequent SQLite database locking during high-frequency workout GPS logging
Maintaining smooth 60fps graph renders on older mobile devices
solutions: Implemented a batched write transaction queue in local database
Used native UI thread execution for visual updates with Reanimated
results: Logged workouts match exactly across offline sessions

title: Lightweight Zod Validator
shortDescription: A blazing fast micro-library for custom Zod validation middleware.
fullDescription: A lightweight Zod validation engine that speeds up API request schemas processing by caching parsing paths. Written in pure TypeScript with zero external dependencies besides Zod itself.
features: Fast path parsing caches for Zod Object schemas
Drop-in Express and Hono framework middleware loaders
Friendly nested validation error structures output
architectureHighlights: Deterministic cache key strings for complex recursive validation trees
challenges: Determining cache key signatures for complex Zod Union/Intersection validation trees
solutions: Developed a custom deterministic stringifier for schema metadata structures
results: Improved middleware execution time by 45% on average
Zero dependency bloat added to microservices using this package

reelSlides.description: Exhibiting 45% faster parse throughput than default Zod execution under stress.

title: TaskFlow Dashboard
shortDescription: A collaborative task management dashboard with real-time updates and team analytics.
fullDescription: TaskFlow is a modern project management tool built for agile teams. Features drag-and-drop Kanban boards, real-time collaboration via WebSockets, sprint planning with velocity tracking, and comprehensive reporting dashboards. Built with a focus on performance and developer experience.
features: Real-time Kanban board with optimistic UI updates
Sprint velocity charts and burndown tracking
Team member workload heatmaps
Automated Slack and email notifications
architectureHighlights: Event-driven architecture with Socket.io for real-time sync
Prisma middleware for audit logging on all mutations
Redis caching layer for dashboard analytics queries
challenges: Handling conflict resolution for concurrent board edits
Optimizing WebSocket connection scaling for 500+ concurrent users
solutions: Implemented operational transformation for board state
Used Redis Pub/Sub with connection pooling for horizontal scaling
results: Reduced task management overhead by 40% for beta teams
Achieved <100ms latency for real-time updates at scale

title: DevMetrics CLI
shortDescription: A command-line tool for analyzing codebase health and team productivity metrics.
fullDescription: DevMetrics is an open-source CLI tool that provides actionable insights into codebase health, team velocity, and code quality trends. It integrates with GitHub, GitLab, and local git repositories to generate comprehensive reports on commit patterns, review times, hotspot detection, and technical debt accumulation.
features: Multi-repository analysis with parallel processing
Interactive terminal UI with progress indicators
Exportable reports in JSON, HTML, and PDF formats
GitHub Actions integration for CI/CD pipelines
architectureHighlights: Streaming parser for large git histories without memory bloat
Plugin architecture for custom metric collectors
Worker thread pool for CPU-intensive analysis tasks
challenges: Processing 100k+ commit histories within reasonable time
Handling API rate limits across multiple Git providers
solutions: Implemented incremental caching with content-addressable storage
Built adaptive rate limiter with exponential backoff
results: 1.2k+ stars on GitHub within first month of release

title: SecureVault Mobile
shortDescription: A zero-knowledge encrypted password manager with biometric authentication.
fullDescription: SecureVault is a privacy-first password manager built for iOS and Android. It uses client-side encryption with Argon2id key derivation, secure enclave/keystore integration for biometric unlock, and supports encrypted vault sharing via QR codes. Zero server-side knowledge architecture ensures user data never leaves the device unencrypted.
features: Argon2id key derivation with hardware-backed key storage
Biometric authentication (Face ID, Touch ID, Android Biometric)
Encrypted vault export/import with QR code sharing
TOTP authenticator with encrypted backup
Breach monitoring via HaveIBeenPwned API (local k-anonymity)
architectureHighlights: SQLCipher for encrypted local database with per-vault keys
Keychain/Keystore integration for master key protection
Offline-first architecture with encrypted sync protocol
challenges: Balancing security with usability for non-technical users
Handling secure element availability across Android OEMs
solutions: Implemented fallback software encryption with clear warnings

title: EdgeAPI Gateway
shortDescription: A high-performance API gateway with rate limiting, auth, and observability built for edge deployment.
fullDescription: EdgeAPI is a lightweight API gateway designed for deployment at the edge (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, Deno Deploy). Written in TypeScript with zero cold-start overhead, it provides JWT validation, configurable rate limiting, request/response transformation, and OpenTelemetry integration out of the box.
features: Sub-millisecond cold starts on Cloudflare Workers
Declarative route configuration with Zod schema validation
Distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry and Jaeger
Per-route rate limiting with sliding window algorithm
JWT/OIDC validation with JWKS caching
architectureHighlights: Middleware pipeline optimized for edge runtime constraints
Config hot-reload without deployment via KV namespace
challenges: Working within 1MB Worker script size limit
Achieving consistent latency across global edge locations
solutions: Regional KV read replicas for config distribution
results: P99 latency <5ms at edge locations worldwide
